   🚀 The Developer shall not be liable for any loss, damage or disclosure of data due to force majeure, hardware failure, software defects, network problems or third-party platform restrictions.

   🚀 Users should understand and accept that there may be unforeseen risks with this plug-in, such as data loss, corruption, or synchronization errors. To the extent permitted by applicable law, Users should assess the risks of use on their own.
   🚀 To the extent permitted by applicable law, the Developer shall not be liable for any loss of data, business disruption, or other damage arising from the use or inability to use this Plugin.
💻2. Privacy and rights

   🚀 Users should properly manage their Git accounts, API tokens, and related credentials and be responsible for their data security and access rights.
💻3. Risks of Use

The availability, stability, security and policy changes of the relevant services are determined by the third party platform and are not under the control and responsibility of the Developer.

💻5. Legal liability

recoverAssetsTips: Restore the local file resource path!
platformTypeDesc: After selection, the cloud synchronization and backup functions will be implemented using this type of platform, such as: cloud disk, git platform.
subGitplatformTypeDesc: The specific platform for storing data, such as :github, etc.
subCloudplatformTypeDesc: The specific platform for storing data, such as: Baidu Netdisk/Alibaba Netdisk, etc.
gitRepoAddressDesc: Please enter the address (full path) of https or ssh in the github repository
cloudAddressDesc: Please enter the address of https or other protocols in the cloud disk (full path)
gitRepoNameDesc: Please enter the name of the warehouse you want to sync to the github warehouse
gitRepoBranchDesc: Please enter the name of the branch you want to sync to the github repository
cloudUserNameDesc: Account name on platforms such as Baidu Netdisk or Alibaba Netdisk
gitUserEmailDesc: The user's email address when synchronizing note data is submitted will be displayed in the submission history
ignoreFilePlaceHolder: Example (separated by semicolons in English format) :.lock; data/*; conf/local.json; data/*.sy
ignoreFileDesc: When synchronizing note data, ignore the files in the text box. [Note] :.lock; Files such as temp/* will not be synchronized.
assetPrefixPlaceHolder:
/data/assets: Starting with "/ "indicates addressing from the root path 
data/assets: Not beginning with "/", addressing from the same-level directory of the file that references the resource file
assetPrefixDesc: Setting this path will replace the resource path [assets/imgxxx.png] in the Source note file with [Set path /imgxxx.pn]
gitTokenORkeyDesc: Login to github to generate a private token or token for authorized access to a remote repository
cloudTokenKeyDesc: The password of the user logging into the cloud disk or the private access token or token used to authorize access to the cloud disk data
enableSyncDesc: It is recommended to manually click the sync button to trigger a sync when changing from disabled to enabled
syncGenConflictFile: Generate conflict documents when synchronizing conflicts
syncGenConflictFileDesc: When enabled, when a synchronization conflict occurs, a conflict document will be generated locally for direct opening and viewing. When turned off, a pop-up will prompt conflict information, but no conflict document will be generated.
noteTypeDesc: After cloud synchronization is enabled, you can further select the format for synchronizing remote note files
syncRangeDesc: After enabling cloud synchronization, you can further select the synchronization range, [workspace], [data directory] : Data directory in the workspace, [note files] : only note files are synchronized, plug-ins will not be synchronized
syncStrategyDesc: After cloud synchronization is enabled, you can further select a synchronization policy. [Manual synchronization] : The user selects cloud coverage or local coverage, [Automatic synchronization] : the system automatically compares file synchronization content, [cloud coverage local] : The cloud is not displayed, and the cloud is directly pulled down to cover local, [local cloud coverage] : Will not bounce, directly local push to cover the cloud
syncModeDesc: Enable GIT remote synchronization to further select the synchronization mode
manualSync: Manual sync (automatically sync once only when starting)
fullManualSync: Full manual synchronization (complete manual synchronization, including startup/shutdown)
syncIntervalDesc: Auto sync interval in SECONDS (min 30). Triggers after data stays unchanged.
latestCommitShaDesc: Hash of the most recent commit of the current device
latestCommitTimeDesc: The last commit time of the current device
fileSyncFailed: ❌ file synchronization failed: Please try again, or contact the developer
createFileTreeFailed: ❌ Failed to create a file submission tree
getCommitsFailed: ❌ Failed to obtain the commit record :
getRepoFileFailed: ❌ failed to obtain the repository file
getFileContentFailed: ❌ Failed to obtain the file content :
binFileCompareNot: Binary file comparison is not supported yet
confirm_modifyrepo_reset_commit: If the repository address / repository name / user name has changed, do I reset the latest local commit record?
confirm_rollback_text: Files with the same file ID in the same path in the current workspace will be overwritten and irrevocable
warnFinishSettingConfig: ⚠️ Please improve the configuration information in [Settings]
checkNetworkLink: Please check the token configuration on the network connection/Settings screen, and then restart Siyuan Note or this plug-in
initCheckNet: Failed to obtain the remote submission information, please initialize the remote repository / check whether the token configuration on the setup interface is correct / check the network connection
noCommitFile: No modified files/No differences in submitted files
updateLocalAssetsPathInfo: ⚠️ Began to update the local resource file path
updateLocalAssetsPathSucc: ✅ The path of the local resource file was updated successfully
updateLocalAssetsPathFailed: ❌ The path of the local resource file was updated failed, please try again!
backupFailed: The system's automatic backup failed. Please manually backup the files to a secure directory and then synchronize the data.
confirm_modifyworkspace_commit: ⚠️ After the synchronization range is modified, the data synchronization will delete the data of the remote out-of-synchronization range content, please confirm whether it is modified?
confirm_sync_refresh_fileTree: Data synchronization has been completed. The file tree indexes of some newly synchronized data are lost. Please confirm whether to re-establish the file tree indexes?
confirm_switch_noteFormat_sync: ⚠️ The note format has been switched and a local overwrite is needed to keep the remote format consistent with the local note format, please confirm whether the [local file overwrite remote] operation is performed immediately (files of the old note format will be deleted)?
confirm_assetsPrefix_illegal:
⚠️ the prefix of the resource file path must end with "assets" or "assets/" 
【 confirm 】 append "assets" after the path; 【 Cancel 】 Clear the input resource path prefix

setting.reconfig_platform: The [Platform Type] in the plugin's [Settings] is incorrect. The system has reselected the default [Git Platform].

warn.logfileClearWarn: ⚠️The large log file has been packaged. Please clean it up in a timely manner as needed!

gSyncConflictDesc: Local and remote data were both modified; auto sync has been paused. Choose how to proceed:
gSyncLaterMsg: Conflict still pending: auto sync stays paused, please handle it later.
gSyncPausedMsg: ⚠️ Sync conflict unresolved, auto sync paused. Please resolve it first.
gSyncPausedTooltip: 【GIT Sync】Conflict unresolved, auto sync paused. Click to handle.
gSyncRestoredPausedMsg: An unresolved sync conflict was detected; auto sync is paused. Click the plugin icon to handle it.
gSyncConflictMsg: 🔴 Sync conflict detected, auto sync paused
gSyncResolveFailedMsg: ❌ Resolution sync failed, conflict still pending
gSyncOpenDocHint: The conflict doc was created next to the original (name contains _conflict_ prefix). Open it in the file tree.
gSyncHistoryError: ❌ The sync history panel is unavailable. Please try again later.
gSyncPersistFailed: ⚠️ State save failed, paused state may be lost after restart
sgspSyncNotifyDesc: Show a notification after each successful sync (default on; when off, failures and conflicts are still notified)
sgspAutoRetryDesc: Automatically retry retryable sync failures (default off; will be enabled in a later version)
gSyncNoChangeMsg: No file changes detected; sync stopped
sygspPersistFailed: Failed to persist state; paused state may be lost after restart
sygspPausedMsg: Sync conflict unresolved, auto sync paused
sygspBaseUnresolvedMsg: Sync base cannot be confirmed, auto sync paused. Open the plugin menu to recover
sygspDiagnosisDesc: All checks below are read-only and never modify local or remote data
sygspBaseRecoveryWarn: A common base cannot be proven between local and remote. Choose one side and run an overriding sync (copies of the overridden side will be exported):
sygspPreviewTitle: Sync plan preview before first write:
sygspMigrated: Migrated {n} settings from legacy SGSP; the sync base must be re-confirmed
sygspDirRemote: ⬇️ Download remote data to overwrite local
sygspDirLocal: ⬆️ Upload local data to overwrite remote
sygspAutoRetryDesc: Limited retries for network timeout and remote-changed errors only
sygspSuccessNotifyDesc: When off, successful auto sync stays silent (manual sync always notifies)
selectCommitHint: Select a commit on the left to view files
emptyFiles: No file changes in this commit
rollbackFile: Roll back: overwrite local with this commit
noLocalCommit: No local commit yet, switched to remote commits
sygspQueueBusy: A sync task is already running; this request has been queued
sygspConflictSetMissing: Conflict details not found; diagnosis panel opened, resync to rebuild the conflict set
sygspDeviceNameDesc: Tags GitHub commit messages with the source device, e.g. pad; leave empty for no prefix
